items.mnemonic: ア: an Antenna mast with one guy-wire sloping down to the left — the left half of 阿. 'Ah!' it says as the signal comes in. Do not mix it up with マ.
イ: a person leaning into the wind, one leg planted — the left side of 伊 (the 亻 shape). 'Ee!' they cry as the gust hits.
ウ: a little roof with a chimney stub on top — the crown of 宇. Rain says 'oo' on the tiles. ワ is the same cup without the chimney.
エ: an Elevator shaft seen from the side: floor, pillar, ceiling. From 江. Step in and say 'eh?' as the doors close.
オ: a stick figure waving a flag — the left of 於. Hiragana お kept the pole and curled the rest. 'Oh!' from the stands.
カ: hiragana か without its little chip — a KAtana blade hooking at the tip. It is simply 加 minus the 口. Swing it: 'ka!'
キ: a KEY: a shaft with two teeth crossing it. Same skeleton as hiragana き with the bottom curl cut off. From 幾.
ク: a beak opening: a bird going 'coo'. From 久. Only two strokes — ケ adds a long bar, タ adds a dot inside.
ケ: ク with a long bar lying across its chest like a KEttle lid — the left part of 介. 'Ke' hisses the kettle.
コ: a square COrner with the left side missing — two strokes from 己. Straight edges; ユ has a base under it and ロ is a closed box.
サ: hiragana さ gone angular — two ears above a bar and a stroke dropping from it: a SAlute, from 散. 'Sa!' barks the soldier.
シ: two short drops stacked on the left, then one long stroke sweeping UP from the bottom — a SHIp's wake, from 之. In ツ the long stroke falls.
ス: a tent rope with a knot: one bar and a tail crossing it — SUpport ropes, from 須. Hiragana す also ends in a little knot.
セ: a sword stuck into a stand — the top of 世. Hiragana せ with corners instead of curves. 'Se!' says the SEntry.
ソ: one drop, then one long stroke SOaring down from the top right — from 曽. Two strokes; ン's long stroke rises from the bottom instead.
タ: ク with a dot inside — a TAlon holding one egg; the top of 多 'many'. Three strokes; ク has only two.
チ: hiragana ち straightened out: it is 千 'thousand', a CHImney with a slanted cap. 'Chi' puffs the smoke.
ツ: two short drops along the top, then one long stroke falling from the top right — 川 'river' tipped sideways, water tumbling: 'tsu'. シ's long stroke rises.
テ: 天 'heaven' with its legs cut off: a TElephone pole with two crossbars and a bent post. 'Te' says the operator.
ト: from 止, cousin of hiragana と: a TOtem pole with one branch jutting out to the right. Lean on it and say 'to'.
ナ: a cross whose lower arm swings off to the left — the top of 奈. A NAil hammered in at an angle. 'Na!'
ニ: two bars — it is the kanji 二 'two' itself. A double-decker sandwich, NIce and simple. Hiragana に carries the same two bars.
ヌ: ス with an extra tick through its middle — the right of 奴. A NUmber of knots; that tick is the thread ス lacks.
ネ: the shrine radical 礻 of 祢: roof, trunk, flared root. Hiragana ね shares the upright stem. 'Ne?' asks the pilgrim.
ノ: one single stroke sweeping down to the left — 乃 stripped bare. A NOse in profile. The easiest kana: 'no'.
ハ: two strokes opening like wings — it is the kanji 八 'eight'. A HAt brim lifting off: 'ha!' Hiragana は keeps none of this shape.
ヒ: 比 cut in half — a HEel kicking up as a runner HIts the track. One corner stroke, one flick across it.
フ: the rim of a FOOd tray seen from the side, hooked at the top right — the top of 不. ヲ is フ with one more bar inside.
ヘ: a flat mountain tent — the right side of 部 and identical to hiragana へ. 'Heh', the easiest twin: nothing to relearn.
ホ: a tree 木 with its branches shaken loose — from 保. A HOuse post with two props. Hiragana ほ keeps the same uprights.
マ: a folded flag with a dot below — the top of 末. MArk the spot. Hiragana ま is its rounder twin. ア has a sweeping tail instead of a dot.
ミ: three strokes, the kanji 三 'three' tilted — a cat's whiskers, 'mi' for MEow. Hiragana み curls them into one loop.
ム: a triangle with a tail: the top of 牟, a MOO-cow's muzzle seen head-on. Hiragana む grows from the same corner.
メ: an X with a slash: 女 'woman' stripped to its cross — a MEssage marked with an X. Hiragana め keeps the cross too.
モ: 毛 'fur' flattened: a hook with two bars across it — a coat hanger with MOre than it can hold. Hiragana も shares the hook.
ヤ: hiragana や straightened: a hook with a dot: a YAcht's hull and sail, from 也. 'Ya!' from the deck.
ユ: a U-turn: hook at the top, flat base beneath — from 由. Hiragana ゆ with the loop knocked square. 'Yoo-hoo!' コ has no base.
ヨ: a comb with three teeth pointing left — the right of 與. A YOga pose with three arms out. Hiragana よ hides the same idea.
ラ: a hat brim over a hook — the top of 良. RAin runs off the brim. Hiragana ら shares the small top stroke.
リ: two down-strokes, the right one longer and bending left — 利's blade side (刂). RIver banks, one long, one short. Hiragana り is the twin.
ル: 流 'flow' simplified — a RUnning stream splitting around a rock. Hiragana る's curl is here cut into two strokes.
レ: a single hook stroke from 礼 — a LAdder's foot kicking out. Hiragana れ hides this hook in its right half. 'Re!'
ロ: a plain square — the box of 呂. A mouth saying 'ro' wide open. Hiragana ろ ROlls where ロ squares off. コ is this box with no left side.
ワ: a shallow cup with a hook on the right — the top of 和. A WAter bowl. ウ wears a chimney on top; ワ does not.
ヲ: フ with an extra bar inside — from 乎. A WOoden tray with a shelf. Rare in modern words; read 'o' like オ, typed 'wo'.
ン: one dot, then one stroke sweeping UP from the bottom left — 'nn', the hum of an eNgine. ソ's long stroke falls; ン's rises.
ガ: カ with two dots at the top right — the katana strikes a GArbage can and two sparks fly. Katakana dakuten sit where hiragana's do.
ギ: キ with two dots — the key turns and two tumblers click: 'gi'. The GEEse outside honk back.
グ: ク with two dots — the bird's beak now GUlps, two drops of water flying off.
ゲ: ケ with two dots — the kettle lid rattles twice: GEt the tea off the heat.
ゴ: コ with two dots — two GOlf balls roll onto the corner shelf.
ザ: サ with two dots — the salute is answered by two ZAps of lightning.
ジ: シ with two dots — two extra drops in the ship's wake: a JEt ski races past.
ズ: ス with two dots — two drops ZOOm off the tent rope in the storm.
ゼ: セ with two dots — the sentry's sword takes two nicks: ZEro damage, he says.
ゾ: ソ with two dots — two sparks trail the soaring stroke: a ZOne of fireworks.
ダ: タ with two dots — the talon drops the egg and two shell bits fly: DArn!
ヂ: チ with two dots — reads 'ji' exactly like ジ, but is almost never used; it survives in a few words such as チヂミ.
ヅ: ツ with two dots — reads 'zu' exactly like ズ; rare, seen mainly on sushi menus in words like ヅケ.
デ: テ with two dots — two birds land on the telephone pole: DEssert is served.
ド: ト with two dots — two knocks on the totem pole: 'don, don', someone at the DOor.
バ: ハ with two dots — the hat brim lifts and two BAts fly out.
ビ: ヒ with two dots — the runner's heel kicks up two BEads of sweat.
ブ: フ with two dots — two BUbbles rise from the food tray.
ベ: ヘ with two dots — two BElls hang from the tent peak.
ボ: ホ with two dots — two BOlts fasten the house post to its props.
パ: ハ with a small circle at the top right — a PArty balloon rising off the hat brim. The circle (handakuten) means 'p'.
ピ: ヒ with a small circle — a PEa balanced on the runner's heel.
プ: フ with a small circle — a POOl of soup bubbles up over the tray rim.
ペ: ヘ with a small circle — a PEbble rolling down the tent roof.
ポ: ホ with a small circle — a POst light glowing above the house post.
キャ: キ followed by a half-size ャ, said as one beat 'kya'. The key opens a tiny yacht locker — a head of CAbbage inside.
キュ: キ plus a small ュ — one beat, 'kyu'. The key fits a small U-shaped lock: a CUte click.
キョ: キ plus a small ョ — one beat, 'kyo'. The key hangs on a tiny three-toothed comb; eyes dart around looking for it.
シャ: シ plus a small ャ — one beat, 'sha'. The ship's wake sprays a tiny sail: a SHIrt hung out to dry.
シュ: シ plus a small ュ — one beat, 'shu'. The wake curls into a tiny U: a SHOE-shaped cream puff.
ショ: シ plus a small ョ — one beat, 'sho'. The wake washes up a tiny comb: a SHOpping bag on the shore.
チャ: チ plus a small ャ — one beat, 'cha'. Smoke from the chimney fills a tiny sail: a CHAnce breeze.
チュ: チ plus a small ュ — one beat, 'chu'. The chimney cap sits on a small U: a tulip bulb, CHOO-choo goes the train.
チョ: チ plus a small ョ — one beat, 'cho'. The chimney puffs over a tiny comb: CHOcolate melting.
ニャ: ニ plus a small ャ — one beat, 'nya', the sound a Japanese cat makes. Two bars and a tiny sail.
ニュ: ニ plus a small ュ — one beat, 'nyu'. Two bars over a small U: fresh NEWs on the rack.
ニョ: ニ plus a small ョ — one beat, 'nyo'. Two bars and a tiny comb: a plate of gnocchi lined up.
ヒャ: ヒ plus a small ャ — one beat, 'hya'. The kicking heel flicks a tiny sail: a whoop of joy.
ヒュ: ヒ plus a small ュ — one beat, 'hyu', the whistle of wind. A heel and a small U: a blown fuse HEWn in two.
ヒョ: ヒ plus a small ョ — one beat, 'hyo'. The heel and a tiny comb: a leopard's spotted paw.
ミャ: ミ plus a small ャ — one beat, 'mya'. The three whiskers and a tiny sail: a cat MEowing in MYAnmar.
ミュ: ミ plus a small ュ — one beat, 'myu'. Three whiskers over a small U: MUsic notes on a stave.
ミョ: ミ plus a small ョ — one beat, 'myo'. Three whiskers and a tiny comb: slivers of myoga on a dish.
リャ: リ plus a small ャ — one beat, 'rya'. Two river banks and a tiny sail: a llama fording the stream.
リュ: リ plus a small ュ — one beat, 'ryu'. River banks over a small U: a RUcksack dropped by the water.
リョ: リ plus a small ョ — one beat, 'ryo'. River banks and a tiny comb: 'ryōkai!' — message received.
ギャ: ギ plus a small ャ — one beat, 'gya'. The voiced key and a tiny sail: a GAllery opening.
ギュ: ギ plus a small ュ — one beat, 'gyu'. The voiced key over a small U: a REGUlar squeeze, 'gyu!'
ギョ: ギ plus a small ョ — one beat, 'gyo'. The voiced key and a tiny comb: a plate of gyoza dumplings.
ジャ: ジ plus a small ャ — one beat, 'ja'. The jet-ski wake and a tiny sail: a jar of JAm.
ジュ: ジ plus a small ュ — one beat, 'ju'. The voiced wake over a small U: JUice in a cup.
ジョ: ジ plus a small ョ — one beat, 'jo'. The voiced wake and a tiny comb: JOgging along the shore.
ビャ: ビ plus a small ャ — one beat, 'bya'. The voiced heel and a tiny sail: a sliver of sandalwood.
ビュ: ビ plus a small ュ — one beat, 'byu'. The voiced heel over a small U: an interVIEW microphone.
ビョ: ビ plus a small ョ — one beat, 'byo'. The voiced heel and a tiny comb: a spring going 'boing'.
ピャ: ピ plus a small ャ — one beat, 'pya'. The pea on the heel and a tiny sail: a spa town far away.
ピュ: ピ plus a small ュ — one beat, 'pyu'. The pea over a small U: a comPUter chip.
ピョ: ピ plus a small ョ — one beat, 'pyo'. The pea and a tiny comb: a rabbit hopping, 'pyon pyon'.
ファ: フ plus a small ァ — one beat, 'fa'. The tray rim and a tiny antenna: FAshion on the runway.
フィ: フ plus a small ィ — one beat, 'fi'. The tray rim and a tiny leaning figure: a strip of FIlm.
フェ: フ plus a small ェ — one beat, 'fe'. The tray rim and a tiny elevator: a caFÉ counter.
フォ: フ plus a small ォ — one beat, 'fo'. The tray rim and a tiny flag: a FOrk laid on the tray.
フュ: フ plus a small ュ — one beat, 'fyu'. The tray rim over a small U: a FUsion dish.
ヴァ: ウ with two dots plus a small ァ — 'va'. The buzzing roof and a tiny antenna: a VIOlin on the rooftop.
ヴィ: ウ with two dots plus a small ィ — 'vi'. The buzzing roof and a tiny figure: a VIntage coat.
ヴ: ウ with two dots — 'vu', the only single kana for a 'v' sound. The roof hums: déjà VU, I have seen this roof before.
ヴェ: ウ with two dots plus a small ェ — 've'. The buzzing roof and a tiny elevator: a VEil in the lift.
ヴォ: ウ with two dots plus a small ォ — 'vo'. The buzzing roof and a tiny flag: a VOcalist on stage.
ヴュ: ウ with two dots plus a small ュ — 'vyu'. The buzzing roof over a small U: a stage reVUE.
シェ: シ plus a small ェ — 'she'. The ship's wake and a tiny elevator: the CHEf steps out.
ジェ: ジ plus a small ェ — 'je'. The jet-ski wake and a tiny elevator: a roller coaster climbing.
チェ: チ plus a small ェ — 'che'. The chimney and a tiny elevator: CHEck the floor number.
ツァ: ツ plus a small ァ — 'tsa'. Tumbling water and a tiny antenna: a pizza spinning in the air.
ツィ: ツ plus a small ィ — 'tsi'. Tumbling water and a tiny figure: a canal in Venice.
ツェ: ツ plus a small ェ — 'tse'. Tumbling water and a tiny elevator: a tsetse fly buzzing.
ツォ: ツ plus a small ォ — 'tso'. Tumbling water and a tiny flag: a canzone sung by the river.
ティ: テ plus a small ィ — 'ti'. The telephone pole and a tiny figure: a TIssue blowing past.
ディ: デ plus a small ィ — 'di'. The voiced pole and a tiny figure: DInner at six.
テュ: テ plus a small ュ — 'tyu'. The pole over a small U: rare, used for foreign names and words.
デュ: デ plus a small ュ — 'dyu'. The voiced pole over a small U: a DUet on two wires.
トゥ: ト plus a small ゥ — 'tu'. The totem pole and a tiny roof: a tattoo of a hut.
ドゥ: ド plus a small ゥ — 'du'. The voiced totem pole and a tiny roof: a Hindu temple.
ウィ: ウ plus a small ィ — 'wi'. The roof and a tiny figure: WHIsky by the fire.
ウェ: ウ plus a small ェ — 'we'. The roof and a tiny elevator: a WEbsite loading.
ウォ: ウ plus a small ォ — 'wo'. The roof and a tiny flag: out WAlking.
